passkeys.introStaff: Two-step verification at every sign-in, and an identity check before viewing a client's access details. With your fingerprint or face, and the key stays on your device.
passkeys.introClient: An extra layer of protection for the portal: after your password or the email link, confirm with your fingerprint or face. The key stays on your device.
passkeys.requiredNote: To view access details in Systems and access, you need at least one passkey.
passkeys.secondDeviceNote: We recommend adding a second device, such as a phone, so losing one does not lock you out. Create a code here, and type it on the new device after your password.
passkeys.backedUp: backed up to the device account
passkeys.addDeviceHint: To sign in from a phone or another computer. Confirm here with your fingerprint, and on the new device type the code after your password, by choosing "This is a new device".
passkeys.createCode: Create a code for a new device
passkeys.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
passkeys.registerAnother: Register another key in this browser or device
passkeys.staffAlwaysOn: For the Ankora team, two-step verification is always on.

secondFactor.verifyCancelled: Verification was cancelled. If this device has no passkey, choose "This is a new device" below.
secondFactor.verifyIncomplete: The device did not complete the verification.
secondFactor.enrollCancelled: Registration was cancelled. You can try again.
secondFactor.enrollIncomplete: The device did not complete the registration.
secondFactor.introPasskey: Your password is correct. Now confirm on your device: fingerprint, face or device PIN.
secondFactor.introCode: On a device where you are already signed in to Ankora, such as your computer, open My profile and choose "Add a device". After your fingerprint, a 6-digit code appears there. Type it here.
secondFactor.introLinked: The code was accepted. Now register this device, and from next time sign in on it with your password and your face or fingerprint.
secondFactor.introEnroll: This account requires verification on your device at every sign-in. Register the device once, and from now on sign in with your password and your fingerprint. It is a good idea to register a second device later, from your profile.
secondFactor.newDevice: This is a new device without a passkey
secondFactor.enrollAndSignIn: Register the device and sign in

shell.tagline: Operational intelligence that gives you time back.

forgot.subtitle: We will send a reset link to your email address. The link is valid for one hour.
forgot.submitted: If an active account matches the details you entered, a password reset link valid for one hour has been sent to it.
forgot.devLink: No email provider is connected yet (Phase 4). Test link:
forgot.privacyNote: If the address exists in the system, an email will be sent. For security reasons we do not say whether it exists.

portal.tasks: See the status of the tasks Ankora handles for you, as they appear in the portal
portal.reports: Read the weekly report, the monthly report and the hour bank
portal.decisions: See decisions waiting for you, and answer them on your behalf if you are an account admin

staff.clients: See the clients and categories you may log time for
staff.timer: Start and stop a timer, and log time on your behalf

consent.permissions: Claude acts with your permissions only: exactly what you see in the system, nothing more. Nothing can be deleted through this connection.

claude.orgSummary: {connected} of {eligible} Ankora users have connected Claude to their account.
claude.revokeNote: Disconnecting here revokes access immediately. Changing your password does too.
